source.name: PR Newswire / Early Warning Services, LLC: Phoenix Suns and Arizona-based Early Warning Services announce multi-year agreement to feature Paze on all Suns jerseys
source.quote: Paze will succeed PayPal as the team's Official Jersey Patch Partner. Beginning with the 2026-27 NBA season, the multi-year partnership will bring the Paze logo to the upper left side of all Suns uniforms.

summary: Jersey patch: Paze (Early Warning Services), succeeding PayPal from 2026-27.
